column2: Where do signed contracts live today? (Google Drive / SharePoint / file server / physical only / mix)
Is there a folder naming convention? Give an example path.
Who has access to that store, and at what level?
Are hard copies scanned? At what quality / DPI?
Do physical files already have a numbering system? If yes, describe it.
Can we have 10 to 20 sample documents across types to test extraction? (redacted is fine)
Which document types matter most to index first?
Is there a retention or destruction policy we must respect?
Any jurisdiction restriction on where the data may be hosted?
Who should own access control once this is real?
